hero.title: The IFA Internet
hero.subtitle: Internet Model of the Theory of Everything — iTOE
hero.tagline: Where All Kinds of Ideas and Knowledge Meet
hero.description: A Unified Meta-Model integrating all fields, including science, mathematics, engineering, and social sciences through a single Consciousness Science (ConSci) Framework. At its core: Consciousness-Energy (CEN), i.e, Ogbe, is everything that really exists.

mission.title: One Framework for Everything
mission.premise: Consciousness-Energy (CEN) is everything that really exists. All phenomena — living and non-living — are manifestations of a single, unified Entity, Ogbe Energy.

pillars.title: Universal Unity
pillars.body: A single unified framework — the Theory of Everything — that integrates all disciplines from physics to philosophy through the lens of Consciousness-Energy.

pillars.title: IFA Foundation
pillars.body: Built on 256 Odu Ifa — ancient Internet Technology developed by the Ifẹ̀ mathematicians Ọrúnmìlà and Ọ̀ṣun — encoded as the IFABit system (Ogbe = IfaZero, Oyeku = IfaOne).

pillars.title: Internet of Internets
pillars.body: IfaNet — the Network of Everything — uses IFA Language (IfaLang) as the universal communication protocol, enabling all fields to speak to one another.

pillars.title: STEAMSEX Integration
pillars.body: Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, Mathematics, Social sciences, Education, and X (Others) — the interdisciplinary Framework for solving complex societal problems.
